notes.title: ❄️🔔❄️ Winter is coming to our galaxy in December 2018
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30774074/dbabf011e76cc6eb5aa3284bd75b85d025421b1d.jpg[/img]

Hello there, 

Winter is coming, bringing the white nebula with it throughout the galaxy from December 1 to 31, 2018!

Through this, one-month event, collect Stardust boxes while playing. Earn your prestigious “Stardust Prospector” title and trade your boxes at the in-game Winter fair to unlock up to 5 cheerful spaceships: 
[list]
[*] Santalibur
[*] Wall-Xmas
[*] Bauble
[*] Krampus
[*] Zel’Grinch
[/list]

Check this short [url=https://beyond-the-void.net/winter-is-coming/][b]article[/b][/url] to discover the Winter skins and how to collect stardust boxes!


The whole team wishes you all a happy holiday season 🎅

notes.title: Patch notes 0.7.3: New mothership, new skil set, new graphic and sound designs...
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30774074/649e65196534aaa42dad300d5ca5ac03cba9c90e.jpg[/img]


Hello everyone, patch 0.7.3 is live! 

There is a [url=https://youtu.be/3070AxZCQ-s] summary in video on youtube [/url]. Below is the full patch note.

[h1][b]New Mothership: Zel’Hactl [/b][/h1]
[b]Auto Attack: [/b]Deals extra damage equivalent to 1% of the target's remaining life.

[b]Passive: Steel Lust[/b]
Each auto-attack fills Zel'Hactl's steel lust gauge (1% for a creep, 2% for a tower, 3% for a mothership). When the gauge is full, Zel'Hactl enters in fury mode for 5 seconds and increases its Fury counter by 1. The fury lasts for seconds and double the auto-attack damage. Fury counter can't exceed 10. 

[b]Ultimate: Darksteel fury[/b]
Instantaneously warp to the enemy mothership. Upon arrival, Zel'Hactl enters in Steel Lust Fury mode for 5 seconds and receives an additional auto-attack damage increase (multiplier = 1 + Fury counter²/10).


[h1][b]New skills: Electro[/b][/h1]
[b]Shocker[/b]: Releases a lightning bolt in the targeted direction, dealing 20+25*Level damage to all affected enemies.
[u]Special effect[/u]: Disables unit's fire system and skills for 1+0.1*Level seconds.

[b]Thunder orbs[/b]: Deals damage 20+20*Level on a cone surface.
[u]Special effect[/u]: Reduces the fire range of the next auto-attacks by 3.5*level%.

[b]Storm Cloud[/b]: Creates an electrical storm around the ship for 1+0.25*level seconds. Enemies inside the storm take 10+3*level damage per second.
[u]Special effect[/u]: Overloads the unit's weapons, causing its next attack to also inflicts (25+1*level)% damage to itself.

[b]Spark Blast[/b]: Fires a projectile at target location that releases a dome of static electricity upon impact. Every enemy units penetrating this dome sees its shield reduced by 25+3*level%. The dome stays active for 2+0.25*level seconds.
[u]Special effect[/u]: Steals shield points of units which marks are consumed to regenerate the mothership's shield.

[b]Overdrive[/b]: Increases the mothership's movement speed by 5*level% for 2+0.3*level seconds. Activation also generates a wave to apply the marks.
[u]Special effect[/u]: Units whose marks are consumed in the wave take 0,06% damage on their hull per unit of movement for the duration of the overdrive.

[b]Ghost[/b]: The mothership camouflages, leaving a ghost that resumes its last actions. Using a skill or attacking reveals the mothership, but it can move freely or warping without being revealed. The skill and the ghost stay active for 5*level seconds. The ghost inflicts 1+0.25*level damage per second and possess as much shield and hull as his owner when it spawns but takes twice damage.
[u]Special effect[/u]: Adds a damage bonus of 20+2*level % on the next use of a skill and reduces Ghost's cooldown by 75%.


[h1][b]Planet [/b][/h1]
[b]Ring[/b]: 1st ring is free.Next rings cost respectively: 90 / 135 / 202 / 303 / 455 / 683 / 1025 / 1537 / 2306 Ambrosium[b]Strategy[/b]: 1st strategy change is without cooldown. Cooldown formula is the following: Time = 10*numberofglobalstrategychange.

[b]Combination[/b]:[list] 	[*]Kinetic energy: For every 200 (formerly 1000) points of damage endured by the mothership, it gains a cumulative shield bonus of 2% (formerly 10%), and its shield regeneration is improved by 2% (formerly 0.1%). Shield bonus can reach 1.2*Basic shield amount at maximum[/*][/list][list] 	[*]Recycling: bonus can reach 1.2*Mothership basic hull amount at maximum[/*][/list]


[h1][b]Tower [/b][/h1]
When destroying towers, you earn respectively 200 / 300 / 400 Ambrosium.Towers have respectively 200 / 400 / 800 shield points and 2800 / 4600 / 8200 hull points.


[h1][b]Motherships[/b][/h1]
[b]Excalibur:[/b]Basic attack damage has been increased from 85 to 100

[b]Fusion:[/b]Movement speed has been increased from 130 units to 150.
After death, when fusion's passive is active, movement speed is now increased by 50% and passive deals more damage (formula and changed for the following: 150*(1+%ultimatecharge)*(totalLife/remainingLife)

[b]Wall k2:[/b]Auto attack: shots slow the target's movement speed by 10% + 5% per shot and increase your damage by 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 points for 1.5 seconds (formerly 20% + 10% per shot and 10% damage per shot). It still stacks up to 5 times, for a maximum of 30% movement speed reduction and 15 damage points.Ultimate: it protects any spaceships in the zone, even enemies.


[h1][b]Spaceships[/b][/h1]
[b]Fighter[/b]: has a total life of 200 (50 shield + 150 hull) instead of 210. It deals 16 damage points instead of 12. Move speed equals 120 units and range equals 120 units

[b]Sniper[/b]: has a total life of 180 (120 shield + 60 hull). It deals 70 damages with a rate of fire of 1.2. Move speed equals 90 units and range equals 300 units.

[b]Mercenary[/b]: has a total life of 260 (80 shield + 180 hull) instead of 210. It deals 50 damage points with a rate of fire of 1. Move speed equals 110 units and range equals 120 units.

[b]Sentinel[/b]: has a total life of 220 (140 shield + 80 hull) instead of 210. It deals 24 damage points with a rate of fire of 0.6. Move speed equals 150 units and range equals 220 units.

Sniper, Mercenary and Sentinel all had the same characteristics in last version. They had 75 shield and 240 hull points for a total life of 315 points. They were dealing 18 damages at a fire rate of 0.8.


[h1][b]Skills[/b][/h1]
[b]Fire:[/b] We increased fire spear, red head and red wire damage. We also increased fire spear and red wire range.

[b]Cryo:[/b] We reduced ice storm and ice ring damage as well as Cryo Scud number of rockets (and therefore damage).


[h1][b]Graphic designs[/b][/h1]
New graphic design for the Ice Storm.
Fusion ultimate has a new icon and power is now displayed next to mothership Icon.
Asteroïdes, harvesters, planet rings and fighters have new graphic designs.
There are animations for ring destruction and tower destruction.Ambrosium and corsair camps have been reworked as well.


[h1][b]Sound design  [/b][/h1]
New theme during skills draft screen.
1st in game theme has changed.
All skills and motherships’ abilities have sound effects now. 

Don't hesitate to join [url=https://discord.me/btv]BtV official discord server[/url].
Thanks for reading and see you beyond the void!

notes.title: We are listed on Toornament esport platform!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30774074/4726e5d3beb723d4ae51e611806b2364b8cb0323.png[/img]

Hello Captains!

As you may have noticed,  we now use a platform called Toornament to organize  Ambro Cups events. We’re glad to annouce that we’re officially listed on this platform 😀

All organizers can now create their Beyond the Void tournaments, and easily engage hundreds of participants
We chose to trust Toornament as it ‘s a free and open solution that provides management software dedicated to videogames. Thanks to its open API, Toornament allow us to use great esports functionalities such as the tournamentTV and widgets.

[b]Now our community has all the necessary tools to create its own Beyond the Void tournaments [/b]🙂

“At Toornament, we strive to include all communities and we are glad to help developers and their respective communities like B2expand with their under development competitive video game Beyond the Void. Millions of players want to participate in tournaments, as it has never been this easy to take part in a competition, and thanks to our expertise, we want to make it just as easy for organizers.”
– Michael Daudignon, Marketing Director at Toornament

[h1]Recent updates on Toornament[/h1]
Toornament, the professional-ready solution for esports organizers to create, manage and share their competitions, unveiled, earlier this month, a new type of tournament structure available for everyone: the Free-for-All match format.

As video game developers, we believe it’s an important feature regarding current trends in video game industry. We might need structures of this kind for future games projects.

[h1]Next tournament organized by B2expand[/h1]
Next Ambro Cup will be organized by B2Expand on Toornament platform from Webedia company. It’s a free and open solution which provides a tournament management software, dedicated to video games. Toornament hosts thousands of esports competitions each month, fostered by a global and seasoned network of community and professional organizers. Thanks to its open API, Toornament supports developers and game studios by building great esports functionalities, based on its tournament engine.

[b]Thanks for reading, see you in game and at Ambro Cup #3![/b]
[url=https://www.toornament.com/tournaments/1474357215918981120/registration/]Register here[/url]

notes.title: Patch note 0.6.2 - Gameplay changes, spectator mode and new lobby
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30774074/5dd776fbc970ece54430154b01d68776440d5321.png[/img]

[h1]Hello Captains[/h1]

Patch 0.6.2 is live and here is the patch note: 

[h1]Gameplay changes [/h1]
Several minor changes have been implemented:
[b]Abilities:[/b] 
All abilities cost no ambrosium
[list]
[*]Fire spear: Damage scale by 18 points per mothership’s level instead of 22.
[*]Cryo Scud: We reworked the formula to calculate damage so that it deals more damage only if almost all rockets hit the enemy. Damage on mothership are decreased by 20%. Aim is to make this ability an ability to clean your lane. 
[*]Ice storm: it now applies only one mark per use. Damage decreased from 25 to 20 and scale by 8 points per mothership’s level instead of 12.  
[*]Ice ring: Cooldown increased from 12 seconds to 30 seconds. Damage decreased from 25 to 20 and scale by 8 points per mothership’s level instead of 10
[/list]

[b]Ring combinations:[/b]
[list] 
[*]Leviathan (2 military rings combination): rank number increases the hull and not the number of Leviathan you can have near you (tool tip correction) 
[*]Ambro shield (Industrial + Engineering rings combination):  Range radius has been reduced to 150. When you cancel an ability it now disable the aura for 16seconds. There is a small issue with the visual effects if you disable the aura when it’s in stand by. 
[*]Ultimate Defense (2 Engineering rings combination): skills hitting the enemy’s mothership grant a 150 bonus shield. It lasts for 1.5 seconds and each succesful skill extends the duration by 1.5seconds.  
[/list]

[h1]Interface changes[/h1]

[b]Lobby interface and menus have been reworked.[/b]
Loading screen and draft session interface will change in next patch.
If you win or lose when your spaceship is destroyed, the « death interface » is removed spo that  you can see the win / lose screen. 

[b]Spectator mode[/b]
Spectator mode has been fixed. An appropriate interface will be implemented before the release. 

[h1]Bug fixes and other changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Spaceships will no longer attack indefinitely the enemy’s motherplanet at the end of a game
[*]Wall-K2 is now targetable with Fusion’s ultimate. 
[*]Issues when reconnecting to an ongoing game are fixed
[*]Auras :
[list][*]are now automatically switched off when your mothership is destroyed. Before you weren’t able to switch them off. 
[*]In previous version you were loosing 100% of the bonus you collected with an aura when you were destroyed. It has been fixed, you now lose 50% of your bonuses. 
[/list]
[/list]


You can find these information in game too. 
Don't forget to join us on [url=http://discord.me/btv]discord[/url] to find players or if you have any issues with the game!

notes.title: Patch 0.5.0 is live - Important gameplay changes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30774074/ce7da6e611ba4880d6394d451c2583efc0a5aab8.png[/img]

[b]Hello everyone[/b],

Finally the patch 0.5.0 is live! See what new content has been released below!

Enjoy the read!

[h1]GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/h1]
[h1]Ring combinations[/h1][list] 	[*]Every ring combination now give an [b]additional ability[/b]. (Use similar to how you currently use your mothership's primary abilities.)[/*] 	[*]Default binds are on keys 1-2-3-4-5.[/*] 	[*]Several identical combinations raise the rank of the ability and therefore its strength.[/*] 	[*]All these abilities cost Ambrosium, and some of them introduce a new concept: auras.[list] 	[*]Auras are abilities you can enable and disable.[/*] 	[*]When activated auras cost Ambrosium overtime until you disable them.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Building the same combination of two rings on multiple planets will improve the bonus effects of the combination.[/*] 	[*]Remember that combinations of Rings now take into account the build order.[/*][/list]First Industrial Ring: Effects how you can deploy abilities, focused on the mid-game.Industrial Ring:[list] 	[*][b]Ambro-Turbine [/b][b](Combo skill)[/b]. The next skill used within the next 3 seconds reduces its cooldown by 50%.[list] 	[*]Costs 100 Ambrosiums and has a cooldown of four seconds.[/*] 	[*]Adds +1 ability rank gives you one more charge.[/*][/list][/*][/list]Military Ring:[list] 	[*][b]Ambro-Canon (Aura)[/b]. Gives auto attack a 10% chance of applying an additionnal mark. (Remember that mark can be fire or cryo. The aura applies a mark similar to the last one. If there was no mark on the enemy mothership then it applies a mark similar to the one applied by the primary skill.)[list] 	[*]Costs 30 Ambrosium per second when active and has a four seconds cooldown.[/*] 	[*]Adds +1 ability rank increases the chance of applying an additionnal mark by another 10%.[/*][/list][/*][/list]Engineering Ring:[list] 	[*][b]Ambro-Bouclie[/b][b]r (Combo skill)[/b]. The next skill that hits the enemy’s mothership provides you a 250 shield points bonus.[list] 	[*]Costs 150 Ambrosium and has a 30 seconds cooldown.[/*] 	[*]Adds +1 ability rank increases the shield bonus amount by 250.[/*][/list][/*][/list] First Military Ring: Calls upon nearby spaceships, focused on impacting the early-game.Industrial Ring:[list] 	[*][b]Gunners (Temporary guardians)[/b]. Calls upon three gunners that stay with your mothership for 10 seconds.[list] 	[*]Costs 150 ambrosiums and has a 30 seconds cooldown.[/*] 	[*]Adds +1 ability rank gives you one additionnal charge.[/*][/list][/*][/list]Military Ring:[list] 	[*][b]Leviathan [/b][b](Guardian)[/b]. Calls upon a Leviathan that stays with your mothership until it is destroyed.[list] 	[*]Costs 150 ambrosiums and has a 30 seconds cooldown.[/*] 	[*]Adds +1 ability rank upgrades the Leviathan characteristics and gives you one additionnal charge.[/*][/list][/*][/list]Engineering Ring:[list] 	[*][b]Infernal Booster (Guardian)[/b]. Calls upon a spaceship that boosts other spaceships (+5 damage // reduces incoming damage by two), stays with your mothership until it is destroyed.[list] 	[*]Costs 150 ambrosiums and has a 30 seconds cooldown.[/*] 	[*]Adds +1 ability rank upgrades the buff that grants the Infernal Booster (x2)[/*][/list][/*][/list]First Engineering Ring: Improves your mothership, focused on impacting the late game.Industrial ring:[list] 	[*][b]Recyclin[/b][b]g (long duration buff)[/b]. Aura that improves the hull each time you destroy an enemy spaceship (+5 hull points per destroyed enemy spaceship).[list] 	[*]Costs 5 Ambrosium per second and has a 2 second cooldown duration.[/*] 	[*]Adds +1 ability rank increases the bonus by +5 hull points per destroyed spaceship.[/*][/list][/*][/list]Military ring:[list] 	[*][b]Kinetic energy [/b] [b](long duration buff)[/b]. Aura that improves the shield each time you received 1000 damage points (+1% max shield and  +0.1% regeneration per 1000 damage taken).[list] 	[*]Costs 5 Ambrosium per second and has a 2 seconds cooldown duration.[/*] 	[*]Adds +1 ability rank increases the bonuses respectivily by +1% and +0.1%.[/*][/list][/*][/list]Engineering ring:[list] 	[*][b]Last defense[/b] [b] (long duration buff).[/b] Aura that cancel enemy’s abilities and that increases your attack damage each time you cancel an ability (+5 attack damage per canceled skill).[list] 	[*]Costs 15 Ambrosium per second and has a 2 seconds cooldown duration.[/*] 	[*]Adds +1 ability rank increases the bonus by +5 damage points per canceled skill.[/*][/list][/*][/list] [h1]Planetary strategy[/h1][list] 	[*]Each planet owned by the player has a linked strategy among three: [b]combat, economic and defense[/b].[/*] 	[*]Strategies are unlocked after the building of the first ring of a planet. This first ring defines the initial planetary strategy.[/*] 	[*]You can now change strategy at any time with a cooldown of 20 seconds before being able to change it.[/*] 	[*]A shortcut allows you to change your planetary strategy quickly.[/*] 	[*]Each strategy now gives you bonuses according to the rings built on the planet.[/*] 	[*]Each ring will give a different bonus according to the selected strategy. Bonuses are cumulative:[/*][/list][b]Combat strategy[/b]: Adds new units for the lane. Each ring replaces a fighter with a special unit.[list] 	[*]Industrial ring: [b]Mercenary[/b] spaceship. Stronger against snipers.[/*] 	[*]Military ring: [b]Sniper[/b] spaceship. Stronger against sentinels[/*] 	[*]Engineering ring: [b]Sentinel[/b] spaceship. Stronger against mercenaries.[/*][/list][b]Economic strategy[/b]: Allows your rings to generate ambrosium. Each ring grants a different method of gathering.[list] 	[*]Industrial ring: produces [b]Harvesters[/b] that mines Ambrosium on the asteroid belt.[/*] 	[*]Military ring: gives you a [b]bounty[/b] for each destroyed enemy spaceship.[/*] 	[*]Engineering ring: produces [b]Recyclers[/b] that recycle wrecks on the lane.[/*][/list][b]Defense strategy[/b]: The planet is protected by a shield, reducing damage taken by 50%. Each ring grants a passive bonus.[list] 	[*]Industrial ring: [b]+2 Ambrosium per second[/b].[/*] 	[*]Military ring: the mothership gains one [b]attack drone[/b], which increases your damage per second.[/*] 	[*]Engineering ring: [b]+15 experience points per second[/b].[/*][/list][h1]Warp mode[/h1][list] 	[*]The mothership is now invisible during the warp and can’t be seen by your opponent on the mini map. (Surprise your enemy!)[/*][/list][h1]TUTORIALS[/h1][h1]Basic tutorial[/h1][list] 	[*]Basic tutorial has been reworked. It is now shorter and easier.[/*][/list][h1]Advanced tutorial[/h1][list] 	[*]Advanced tutorial is now available.[/*] 	[*]Learn in it how to build rings and understand planetary strategy.[/*][/list][h1]USER EXPERIENCE[/h1][h1]In-Game Interface[/h1][list] 	[*]In-Game user interface has been completely reworked and fits with gameplay changes.[/*][/list][h1]Player level[/h1][list] 	[*]You’ll now gain experience points at the end of every match.[/*] 	[*]Every time you level up you’ll receive extra Battle Points![/*] 	[*]Unlock new titles by levelling up![/*][/list][h1]BP / XP Bonuses[/h1][list] 	[*]We implemented events system to increase BP and XP earnings during targeted times. (Follow us on discord so you don't miss our events!)[/*][/list][h1]MISC. CHANGES[/h1][list] 	[*]New victory soundtrack[/*] 	[*]New defeat soundtrack[/*] 	[*]Normal more reactivated – practice without alternating your rank![/*] 	[*]Ancient rune camp has been reworked[/*] 	[*]3rd abilities (utilitary) now cost 15 Ambrosium per use.[/*] 	[*]Bug fixes[/*][/list] We hope you'll like all these changes!Don't hesitate to tell us how you feel about this new version of Beyond the Void on our [url=discord.me/btv] discord server[/url]. 

You can watch this new patch with the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4J8dDaqz8s0&feature=youtu.be] Official presentation video[/url]. 

Note: We were waiting for this new version to organize new tournaments...Have a nice day!

[b]Ambro-Turbine [/b][b](Combo skill)[/b]. The next skill used within the next 3 seconds reduces its cooldown by 50%.
Adds +1 ability rank gives you one more charge.

[b]Ambro-Canon (Aura)[/b]. Gives auto attack a 10% chance of applying an additionnal mark. (Remember that mark can be fire or cryo. The aura applies a mark similar to the last one. If there was no mark on the enemy mothership then it applies a mark similar to the one applied by the primary skill.)
Adds +1 ability rank increases the chance of applying an additionnal mark by another 10%.
[b]Ambro-Bouclie[/b][b]r (Combo skill)[/b]. The next skill that hits the enemy’s mothership provides you a 250 shield points bonus.
Adds +1 ability rank increases the shield bonus amount by 250.
[b]Gunners (Temporary guardians)[/b]. Calls upon three gunners that stay with your mothership for 10 seconds.
Adds +1 ability rank gives you one additionnal charge.
[b]Leviathan [/b][b](Guardian)[/b]. Calls upon a Leviathan that stays with your mothership until it is destroyed.
Adds +1 ability rank upgrades the Leviathan characteristics and gives you one additionnal charge.
[b]Infernal Booster (Guardian)[/b]. Calls upon a spaceship that boosts other spaceships (+5 damage // reduces incoming damage by two), stays with your mothership until it is destroyed.
Adds +1 ability rank upgrades the buff that grants the Infernal Booster (x2)
[b]Recyclin[/b][b]g (long duration buff)[/b]. Aura that improves the hull each time you destroy an enemy spaceship (+5 hull points per destroyed enemy spaceship).
Adds +1 ability rank increases the bonus by +5 hull points per destroyed spaceship.
[b]Kinetic energy [/b] [b](long duration buff)[/b]. Aura that improves the shield each time you received 1000 damage points (+1% max shield and  +0.1% regeneration per 1000 damage taken).
Adds +1 ability rank increases the bonuses respectivily by +1% and +0.1%.
[b]Last defense[/b] [b] (long duration buff).[/b] Aura that cancel enemy’s abilities and that increases your attack damage each time you cancel an ability (+5 attack damage per canceled skill).
Adds +1 ability rank increases the bonus by +5 damage points per canceled skill.
Each planet owned by the player has a linked strategy among three: [b]combat, economic and defense[/b].
Strategies are unlocked after the building of the first ring of a planet. This first ring defines the initial planetary strategy.
You can now change strategy at any time with a cooldown of 20 seconds before being able to change it.
Each strategy now gives you bonuses according to the rings built on the planet.
Industrial ring: [b]Mercenary[/b] spaceship. Stronger against snipers.
Military ring: [b]Sniper[/b] spaceship. Stronger against sentinels
Engineering ring: [b]Sentinel[/b] spaceship. Stronger against mercenaries.
Industrial ring: produces [b]Harvesters[/b] that mines Ambrosium on the asteroid belt.
Military ring: gives you a [b]bounty[/b] for each destroyed enemy spaceship.
Engineering ring: produces [b]Recyclers[/b] that recycle wrecks on the lane.
Industrial ring: [b]+2 Ambrosium per second[/b].
Military ring: the mothership gains one [b]attack drone[/b], which increases your damage per second.
Engineering ring: [b]+15 experience points per second[/b].
The mothership is now invisible during the warp and can’t be seen by your opponent on the mini map. (Surprise your enemy!)
Basic tutorial has been reworked. It is now shorter and easier.
Advanced tutorial is now available.
Learn in it how to build rings and understand planetary strategy.
In-Game user interface has been completely reworked and fits with gameplay changes.
You’ll now gain experience points at the end of every match.
Every time you level up you’ll receive extra Battle Points!
Unlock new titles by levelling up!
We implemented events system to increase BP and XP earnings during targeted times. (Follow us on discord so you don't miss our events!)
New victory soundtrack
New defeat soundtrack
Normal more reactivated – practice without alternating your rank!
Ancient rune camp has been reworked

notes.title: Patch Note 0.4.7 - Winter Event
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30774074/04458b468b2461d22055baa1882a784941cfa269.png[/img]

[b]WINTER EVENT: THE WHITE NEBULA EVENT![/b]
A supernova has just exploded Beyond the Void, leaving a white nebula in its wake across the galaxy. Thankfully the Archbaron has produced an ambrosium aura, protecting the planets from the white nebula and preserving their existence.
We added some visuals in-game and bonuses for the White Nebula Event:
- Gifts, snow, and glitter in space and in the lobby.
- +20% Battle Points at the end of each game.
- Earn a special edition holiday title for winning two games (ranked) while defending the galaxy from the white nebula!
This event will end on January 3rd. Enjoy Winter!

[b]LOBBY[/b]
The lobby has been improved, you can now see news, last patch note, event, skills collection, tutorial, etc...

[b]TUTORIAL (PART ONE)[/b]
We finally did the first part of the in-game tutorial! Now you have the opportunity to learn more easily the basics of the game.

[b]BATTLE POINTS[/b]
Now you earn Battle points (BP) at the end of each game against a player. 
This BP can be spent in-game to unlock the free to play content. You are now able to unlock new skills with your BP. 

[b]EXPERIENCE[/b]
You no longer gain XP with rings. Now you gain XP when destroying stuff: Ship, motherships, War tower, etc....

[b]NEUTRAL CAMPS[/b]
All camp have been reworked now with the new system. They will receive a visual update soon!

[b]SKILLS[/b]
All skill have been reworked! You can see them all in the lobby now in the “Collection” tab. 
Most of the skills can be used on structure now (turret, war tower, etc).
[list]
[*][b]Mark system[/b]
We reworked all the skills and introduced the “mark” system.
How does it works?
Each skill is based on one element: Fire or Cryo.
Each skill applies one (or many) mark when you hit the enemy’s mothership.
If there is enough mark of a type on the enemy’s mothership, the skill will consume them instead to do an additional effect.

[*][b]Scaling[/b]
Now all the skills are scaling according to your level. To make it simple: you will deal more damage at level 15 than level 1. In a game, you can use [Alt] key to see the formula of a skill in the tooltips.
[/list]

[b]VISUAL UPDATES[/b]
Wall-k2 received a light visual update.
The War tower have been reworked and decorated for the “White nebula” event.

[b]OTHER[/b]
Now you can use a combination of keys in the settings to map your shortcut. All shortcuts have been reset.
Echap now opens the setting menu.
The fighters now spawn every 20 seconds (was 30 seconds previously).

notes.title: Patch notes - 0.4.6
notes.content:
Version 0.4.6

[b]General[/b]
Removed the camera reset on respawn.
Locked the normal games access to open the ranked games so players won’t be split in two queues.
Improvement of the server connection & the reconnection system.

[b]Translations[/b]
Added Polish, Portuguese and Spanish.

[b]Settings[/b]
[b]Smart cast available[/b]
Set the hotkey (default: Left alt) in settings then use this hotkey with your skill to cast it instantly.
[b]Map hotkey[/b]
Use this hotkey (default: Left control) with your rightclick to move your mothership with the map, you won’t have to worry about unintended warp because of a miss click.
[b]Mouse lock[/b]
Added a toggle for choosing whether to lock or not the mouse inside the window while in a game.

[h1]Version 0.4.5[/h1]
[b]General[/b]
Fix of an issue causing lag to all clients
Stability of the connection should be improved
Update of the new shader to add some reflection to Excalibur & Fusion

[b]Lobby[/b]
The “profil” is now accessible. You should be able to select your title, avatar and holotag with it if you have any.
Sound design & Music added

[b]Planets[/b]
The second set of planets now spawn at 6 minutes

[b]Camp (mining colony)[/b]
The neutral camps have been reworked. We are testing this new system with the first camp: the mining colony.
Now the reward scale with the duration of the game.
The others neutral camps should be updated next time.

[b]Kamikaze factory[/b]
Correction of a bug making the kamikaze production way faster than usual…
Now each Kamikaze should take 15 seconds to be built

[b]Kamikaze[/b]
Damage on the main target increased from 80 to 130
Splash damage decreased from 80 to 65
Now stay closer to the factory
Hostile detection range increased from 200 to 300

[b]All Motherships[/b]
The gain from updating the attack speed has been increased from 8% to 10%

[b]Fusion[/b]
[i]Fusion received a visual update ![/i]
Shield decreased from 1100 to 1000
Damage decreased from 70 to 65
